This morning, I wore a purple shirt. My sister said it was too short. My brother thought it was too dark. The shirt got torn, and my arm got hurt. After that, I got dirt on my shirt. My mother said she wants to burn that purple shirt! Esta mañana, me puse una camisa morada. Mi hermana dijo que era demasiado corta. Mi hermano pensó que era demasiado oscura.
